title: Project Serpo exchange program

tellings.quote: And like Serpo is about an alien exchange program essentially where um apparently we sent we after Roswell the crash happened the recovered EBE right extraterrestrial biological entity

plain: After the Roswell crash of 1947, a recovered being, an "EBE" or extraterrestrial biological entity, is said to have led to an exchange programme in which the United States sent people to the beings' home planet, Serpo, a story laid out in papers known as the Project Serpo documents. An unnamed researcher tells Michels this second-hand, linking it to the physicist Hal Puthoff, to a man named Richard Doty and to the DIA, the Pentagon's Defense Intelligence Agency. If true, it would mean humans had visited another world in a secret swap with aliens.
